reviews.title: Very nice fans
reviews.comment: Run nice and quite with plenty airflow and good cable length, if you want to use them with a radiator or in a restricted environment, id probably go with the static pressure version.

reviews.title: Great airflow for PC builds!
reviews.comment: I bought this fan for my recent PC build and it works great. The airflow is excellent and it helps keep my system cool without much noise. Definitely a solid choice if you're looking for an efficient 140mm fan!
